The '''palace''' of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Diago Hixan]] was his summer residence, located within the northern part of the [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|Jundland Chasm]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="BO" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}} The events on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for the Smuggler class, which include the encounters with Nariel Pridence, occur during Act I, placing them in 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the palace was attacked by [[Imperial commando (Sith Empire)|Imperial commandos]] under the orders of the [[Sith Order (Sith Empire)|Sith]] [[Vaverone Zare]], during the [[search for Nok Drayen's treasure]].<ref name="BO" />
